title: GitHub pushes cannot refresh the hosted board
description:
## Problem
The hosted board at `/dev/anthus/kanbus/` works after a **manually signed** POST to `/internal/webhooks/github` with `X-Kanbus-Account` and `X-Kanbus-Project`.

GitHub cannot send those headers. `AnthusAI/Kanbus` also has no webhook to KanbusCloudFoundation (only Amplify and Snyk). Live `develop` pushes do not refresh EFS.

## Why registering the current URL is not enough
`webhook_handler.py` returns 400 without `X-Kanbus-Account` / `X-Kanbus-Project`. A GitHub repository webhook only sends `X-Hub-Signature-256`, `X-GitHub-Event`, and `X-GitHub-Delivery`.

## Locked direction (unless planner finds a better one-way)
1. Accept tenant from the path, e.g. `POST /internal/webhooks/github/{account}/{project}`, same HMAC secret. Keep one way; do not also require headers.
2. Gherkin first; Python and Rust parity if any CLI/docs mention the contract.
3. Register a GitHub `push` webhook on AnthusAI/Kanbus to that URL with the Secrets Manager HMAC secret.
4. Prove with a real GitHub delivery (or GitHub redélivery of a push) that `anthus/kanbus` syncs without custom headers.

## DoD
- GitHub can POST without `X-Kanbus-*` headers and still enqueue the right tenant.
- Hook exists on AnthusAI/Kanbus pointing at KanbusCloudFoundation ingress.
- A real push (or GitHub redélivery of a push) creates S3 `anthus/kanbus/{sha}.tar.gz` and `.synced.json`.
- No NAT, no interface endpoints, no Fargate.

## Out of scope
Wiki 404 on the hosted console. Merge to main.

## Worktree
Planner names a unique worktree and branch from origin/develop. PR to develop only.
